Зачем организации кадровый резерв, если: Why an organization needs a talent pool when there is a labor market
Внешний наём закрывает вакансию, но не з: External hiring fills a vacancy but does not close the gap in knowledge of the organization. We look at when a talent pool is cheaper than hiring, and why.
Три источника выдвижения кандидатов и по: Three sources of candidate nominations and why all three are needed
Руководитель, кадровая служба и сам рабо: The manager, HR and the employees themselves see different things. Dropping any source systematically loses some candidates.

Метод даёт картину восприятия, а не карт: The method shows how behavior is perceived, not what results were achieved. Confusing the two is the main reason for disappointment with 360°.
Полнота оценки: почему её нужно показыва: Assessment coverage: why it must be shown next to the result
Соответствие сорок процентов при покрыти: A forty percent match with thirty percent coverage does not mean a weak candidate; it means an unfinished procedure.
Модель 70—20—10 и что с ней делать на пр: The 70–20–10 model and how to use it in practice
Основную часть развития даёт работа, а н: Most development comes from work, not training. This leads to a specific way of building a development plan.
Почему мероприятие закрывается документо: Why an activity is closed with a document, not a button
Требование подтверждения снижает долю вы: Requiring evidence lowers the share of completed plans, and that is the price for the remaining share meaning something real.
Наставничество: пара, а не поручение: Mentoring: a pair, not an assignment
Ссылка на наставника в карточке мероприя: Naming a mentor on an activity card does not create mentoring. It needs a term, a goal and a measurable result.
Глубина скамейки и покрытие: два разных: Bench strength and coverage: two different questions
Организация может иметь стопроцентное по: An organization can have one hundred percent coverage of critical positions and zero readiness for someone leaving tomorrow.
Критичность и риск освобождения — незави: Criticality and vacancy risk are independent values. Planning priority is their product.
Метод анализа иерархий: зачем сравнивать: The analytic hierarchy process: why compare criteria in pairs
Прямое назначение весов не проверяемо. П: Assigning weights directly cannot be verified. Pairwise comparison makes the inconsistency of judgments measurable.
Энтропийные веса: когда данные говорят с: Entropy weights: when the data speak for themselves
Критерий, по которому все кандидаты один: A criterion on which all candidates are the same distinguishes nothing. The entropy method measures exactly that.

Если при изменении веса на пять проценто: If a five percent change in a weight moves the first candidate to fourth place, the ranking decides nothing.
Как узнать, состою ли я в кадровом резер: How do I find out whether I am in the talent pool?
Откройте раздел «Мой профиль». Если вы в: Open "My profile". If you are in the talent pool, it shows the target position, the date you were added and your current readiness level. The system also notifies you by notification and email when you are added.
Могу ли я подать заявку на включение в р: Can I nominate myself for the talent pool?
Да. В разделе «Заявка в резерв» выберите: Yes. In "Talent pool nomination", choose the target position and justify the nomination. It is reviewed by your line manager and HR; you can follow its progress in the same section.
Почему у меня низкий индекс готовности п: Why is my readiness index low when my ratings are good?
Индекс складывается из шести критериев,: The index is made up of six criteria, and the competency assessment is only one of them. The breakdown by criteria on your talent pool record shows which criterion pulls the value down. A common reason is incomplete assessment: a criterion without data is excluded from the calculation.
Кто видит мои оценки компетенций: Who can see my competency ratings?
Ваш непосредственный руководитель, кадро: Your line manager, HR and the system administrator. Your colleagues cannot see your ratings. 360° feedback is shown to you anonymously: you see the distribution of ratings but not who gave them.
Что делать, если я не согласен с оценкой: What should I do if I disagree with a rating?
Обратитесь к руководителю, проводившему: Talk to the manager who carried out the assessment: the result is discussed before it is approved. An approved rating can be changed only by HR with a stated reason, and the change is recorded in the log.
План утверждается руководителем и являет: The plan is approved by your manager and is a working document. Activity deadlines are monitored and the system reminds you when a deadline approaches. Not completing the plan is grounds for reviewing your place in the talent pool.
Как выдвинуть подчинённого в кадровый ре: How do I nominate a direct report for the talent pool?
В разделе «Мои сотрудники» откройте карт: In "My team", open the employee's card and create a nomination. The system checks the formal conditions, such as tenure and the absence of blocking gaps in critical competencies, and shows what prevents the nomination.
Почему система не даёт включить сотрудни: Why won't the system let me add an employee to the talent pool?
Проверка условий возвращает перечень при: The eligibility check lists the reasons: insufficient tenure in the position, an unmet critical requirement of the target position profile, or a missing assessment. An unassessed critical competency blocks the nomination just like a failed one: the absence of a check is not proof of fit.
Чем результативность отличается от потен: What is the difference between performance and potential in the matrix?
Результативность — то, что работник уже: Performance is what the employee has already achieved in the current position. Potential is the ability to handle more complex tasks. High performance does not predict success in a management position, which is why there are two axes.
Зачем нужна сессия калибровки: What is a calibration session for?
Чтобы планки оценок совпадали между подр: To make rating standards consistent across units. Without calibration, "high potential" means different things in different departments, and employees cannot be compared across units.
Как утвердить план развития подчинённого: How do I approve a direct report's development plan?
План приходит на утверждение с уведомлен: The plan comes for approval with a notification. The plan card shows the activities, the competencies they address and the deadlines. Once approved, the plan takes effect and the employee is notified.
Как выбрать схему оценивания для расчёта: How do I choose the scoring scheme for the index?
Схема по умолчанию применяется к рабочим: The default scheme is applied to live talent pool records. The other schemes are for research runs: they do not change readiness levels or send notifications to talent pool members.
Что означает предупреждение о согласован: What does the consistency warning mean when entering weights?
Отношение согласованности выше 0,1 означ: A consistency ratio above 0.1 means the pairwise judgments contradict each other: for example, the first criterion is more important than the second, the second more important than the third, but the third more important than the first. Weights from such a matrix must not be used; refine the judgments.
Почему энтропийная схема исключила часть: Why did the entropy scheme exclude some criteria?
Критерий, обеспеченный данными менее чем: A criterion with data for fewer than a third of candidates produces meaningless entropy. Such criteria are excluded, and the reason is recorded in the scheme description.
Как проверить, что ранжирование устойчив: How do I check that a ranking is robust?
В разделе аналитики есть анализ устойчив: The analytics section has a robustness analysis: weights are varied one at a time, the calculation is repeated and the orders are compared. Low correlation means the candidates are comparable, and the decision is made by the committee, not the model.
Как выгрузить состав резерва для доклада: How do I export the talent pool roster for a report?
Раздел «Отчёты», отчёт «Состав кадрового: Go to "Reports" and choose "Talent pool roster". Word, Excel, PDF and CSV formats are available. The export is saved with its parameters, so a report that has been presented can be reproduced exactly.
Сколько хранятся сформированные отчёты: How long are generated reports kept?
Девяносто дней. Выгрузка содержит персон: Ninety days. Exports contain personal data, and keeping them indefinitely would extend processing without grounds. A report can be reproduced by running it again.
Как восстановить доступ, если забыт паро: How do I regain access if I forgot my password?
На странице входа выберите «Восстановить: On the sign-in page, choose "Restore access" and enter your work email. The password reset link is valid for a limited time and expires after use.
После нескольких неудачных попыток входа: After several failed sign-in attempts in a row the account is temporarily locked. This protects against password guessing. Contact the system administrator or wait for the lock to be lifted.
Можно ли отключить письма от системы: Can I turn off emails from the system?
Да, в разделе «Настройки». Отключение не: Yes, in "Settings". This does not apply to messages about being added to or removed from the talent pool: these are HR decisions that affect the employee directly.
Что фиксируется в журнале аудита: What is recorded in the audit log?
Изменения кадровых данных, решения по ре: Changes to HR data, talent pool decisions, report exports and views of restricted information. Log entries are kept for three years and cannot be edited.
Поддерживается ли работа с мобильного ус: Can I use the system on a mobile device?
Да. Интерфейс приспособлен к узким экран: Yes. The interface adapts to narrow screens: tables scroll horizontally and the menu collapses. Heavy tasks such as calibration or weight setup are easier on a large screen.
